selection: design sample of the calculator view for the PV lifetime balance page: three components, everything that depends on the initial phrase defined by triples
description: The machine readable form of docs/llm/new_view_sample_pv_balance.md, not imported by any test: the component types and the calculator keyword triples do not exist yet. The system part (the words, the triples with a code_id, the components, the views and the view relation) belongs to a system file calculator_keywords.json, the use case part (the triples without a code_id) to pv_lifetime_balance.json. A label or hint is the description of a triple from the item to the calculator label or calculator hint keyword, the order of a list is a chain of order triples: each item except the first is follower of the item before.

words.name: calculator
words.description: a page that calculates results from the inputs of the user for one initial phrase e.g. a PV installation

words.name: hint
words.description: a short help text shown next to or below a label

words.name: highlight
words.description: a mark that makes an item stand out e.g. a key row of a result table

words.name: sign
words.description: whether a number is positive or negative

triples.name: zukunft.com system
triples.description: keyword for system internal triples such as the column definitions

triples.name: calculator (system)
triples.description: keyword of the calculator view; a phrase that can be a calculator gets its page by the triples of the keywords below

triples.name: calculator label
triples.description: text property: the description of a triple from an item to this keyword is the label of the item e.g. the page title, a heading, a field label, a column header or a row label

triples.name: calculator hint
triples.description: text property: the description of a triple from an item to this keyword is the hint of the item e.g. the lead text or the sub text of a row

triples.name: calculator input
triples.description: list: the items of the group triple to this keyword are the input fields

triples.name: calculator assumption
triples.description: list: the assumptions shown first and with a label; the other operands follow sorted by label

triples.name: calculator result column
triples.description: list: the column phrases of the main result table

triples.name: calculator row group
triples.description: list of lists: the row groups of the main result table, each with its rows; a row has with filters and has a side results

triples.name: calculator detail table
triples.description: list: the detail tables, each with its columns (has a) and its extra rows (with)

triples.name: calculator highlight
triples.description: flag: an item with a triple to this keyword is shown as a key row

triples.name: calculator signed
triples.description: flag: the cells of a row group with a triple to this keyword show the sign of the number

components.name: title calculator
components.description: the calculator label of the page phrase, or of the phrase it is built from, as the page title and its calculator hint as the lead text

components.name: calculator input
components.description: the input fields of the calculator input items, the refresh button and the assumptions in a collapsed block

components.name: calculation result
components.description: the main result table by the column and row group items, then the detail tables, the formula notes and the sources in a collapsed block

components.name: title calculator editor
components.description: the title of the editor with the calculator label and a link back to the calculator page

components.name: calculator setting tree
components.description: one table per calculator keyword with the items of the calculator in their order: up and down links that change the order triples, phrase, label, hint, remove and an empty row to add an item

components.name: calculator label list
components.description: all label and hint triples of the calculator in one table, selected by the calculator label and calculator hint parent

components.name: calculator field settings
components.description: the field triples and values of the input and assumption phrases, which change the field on every page of the phrase

components.name: calculator derived parts
components.description: read only: the derived assumptions, notes and sources with links to their editors

components.name: calculator editor save
components.description: the form of the editor that shows the editor again with the changes

views.name: Calculator
views.description: the inputs and the results of one initial phrase e.g. a PV installation; what the page shows is defined by the calculator triples of the phrase

views.name: Calculator editor
views.description: change the calculator triples of a phrase: the inputs, the assumptions, the columns, the rows, the detail tables, the labels and the hints
